fields.description: Discovery Chain instruction placed in Phase 4 but findings created in Phases 0-3
Nested code fence in recommendation escalation template renders ambiguously
Recommendation escalation writes to PUNCHLIST.md before file structure exists
Lifecycle patterns-brief preservation instruction is contradictory
Strategy and Active Lens sections have no procedural update triggers in Phases 1-4
Phase 0 Pattern Brief read has no sequencing relative to recon steps
Targeted recon: read all 6 changed files + full diff
Final verification: 39 tests passing, sample punchlist valid

fields.recommendations:
1. **26 tests now cover all critical paths.** Maintain the suite on all future changes.
2. **Code-fence pre-processing** is the highest-value remaining improvement. When added, it fixes 5 deferred items simultaneously. Recommend doing this as a dedicated feature, not a bugfix, with its own test suite.
3. **CRLF is now handled.** But if other scripts are added, apply the same `content.replace('\r\n', '\n')` pattern.
4. **History schema is now safe.** The `_get_punchlist()` helper handles any malf
